panels.description: Conclusion of the `triage` job in the most recent scheduled triage-scan run. The run-level conclusion (in the table to the right) is always `success` because the `window` gate job runs; this stat surfaces whether the actual triage work happened. "outside window" (gray) is healthy — the cron fired during quiet hours (outside overnight 01-04 CDT / work-hours 09-12 CDT M-F) and the triage job correctly exited. "failed" (red) means real breakage.

panels.description: Outstanding open-issue counts for this repo in each ADR-0043 state bucket. ONE GraphQL call per panel (multiple aliased searches - 8 calls/refresh fleet-wide vs the REST search API's 30/min budget that previously starved the row). Each bar is a direct positive query; the same issue can appear in multiple buckets if it carries labels matching more than one — these panels are state breakdown, not partition.
